headline: Investing in People

result.label: The idea: a penny from every transaction, made visible
result.note: No figure published; campaign result not yet stated on millergroup.com

summary: A community credit union with a penny-per-transaction giving program nobody was talking about. We built the acquisition campaign around the power of a single penny.

question.h: From community goodwill to new members.
question.p: Founded in 1958, Mocse Credit Union serves nearly 30,000 members across four Northern California counties. As a longtime supporter of the annual Love Modesto event, Mocse wanted to use the occasion to attract new — and especially younger — members. We were tasked with turning community goodwill into a strategic member acquisition campaign.

found.p: Mocse donates a penny from every debit card transaction to the Love Stanislaus fund, reinforcing its commitment to community development, financial education, and local business.

made.h: The power of a single penny.
made.p: Building on this idea, we created a campaign around the power of a single penny — showing how small, everyday choices can grow into financial stability and a stronger community. Through bold brand activations and onsite messaging, we positioned the penny as both a symbol of smart money management and a meaningful way to give back.
